data.completion_memo: Implemented the LocalSqlite semantic ledger and its sole atomic commit API. SQLite is initialized with foreign keys, WAL, and FULL synchronous mode; an IMMEDIATE transaction verifies expected stream head then commits contiguous immutable events, optional attempt/checkpoint, deduplication receipt, and ordered outbox entries together. Identical idempotency retries return the stored receipt, changed-hash key reuse rejects, stale heads roll back with no partial rows, and semantic/outbox payload validation excludes secret/token/lease material. Added read-only event ID and pending-outbox access plus idempotent delivery marking, with tests covering full commit, dedup retry, stale-head atomicity, and secret rejection. cargo test -p aworkit-local-store passes.
data.description: Implement the LocalSqlite semantic Chat/Run ledger and LocalHistoryCommitPort transaction. A commit must atomically enforce the expected stream head and persist semantic events, attempt/head state, optional checkpoint, command and invocation deduplication, and delivery outbox rows before acknowledgement.
